categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches core wallet scan infrastructure (`src/wallet/scan.cpp`, `scan.h`, and `wallet.cpp`) and bears the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Parallelizing BIP 157/158 block filter checks yields a major speedup for wallet imports and rescans. Reviewer benchmarks confirm a 4.5x to 6x reduction in scan duration (dropping a 200,000-block scan from ~280s to 25–63s), directly addressing slow rescans highlighted in the category rubric.
